versions.changelog:
- Major update focused on production-ready, reputation-safe B2B outreach workflows and rules.
- Adds pre-flight safety checklist: lessons learned review, reply/bounce check, duplicate prevention, strict daily send limits for domain health.
- Introduces a detailed prospect qualification decision tree (focus on traditional industries behind on AI adoption).
- Stronger, explicit email verification and bounce handling rules to prevent sender/domain reputation damage.
- Updated and improved outreach email template, including actionable mini-audit guidance and new subject line strategies based on real-world results.
- Enhanced pipeline and bounce tracking; clearer instructions for scaling and context recall.
